hike log#423

the fog hadn't lifted yet
when she looked up

lake chabot regional park  ·  oakland, ca
datesept 27, 2026
conditionsovercast, still
terraineucalyptus ridge, reservoir shoreline
companyone deer, unbothered

Some mornings the water does all the talking.

No wind yet, no sun yet — just grey light easing over green water, eucalyptus bark peeling in long ribbons, and a trail that hadn't decided what it was doing before it dropped down to the shore. Then a deer, ten feet off the path, more interested in breakfast than in me.

the trail, before and after the deer — five frames from an ordinary loop
— logged, one loop at a time
